authoritative_policy.debug_configuration: 3★ E1/max level, skill rank 7, potential 1, trust 0; 1★/2★ phase 0/max level; all trust 0

rules.coordinates: OperationalPlan/action JSON tile is [row,col]. Runtime tile is (x=col,y=row), converted as (col,row).
rules.damage: Current formula layer: physical max(0.05A,A-D); arts max(0.05A,0.01A*(100-RES)); attack interval T0/(clamp(S,10,600)/100).
rules.economy: Natural DP and provided ledger deltas are model calculations. Refunds, skill DP and merchant upkeep are only valid with their stated evidence and conditions.
rules.range_orientation: GameData range offsets are stored for RIGHT. ApproximateRealRangeTransformer rotates them in bottom-left field coordinates.
rules.simulator_win: Current Simulator wins when no enemy leaks, the spawn schedule is exhausted, and no active enemies remain.
rules.time_sp_recovery: Current public low-rarity runtime advances time-SP by 1.0 SP/s only while inactive. SP is paused while a skill is active.
rules.unknown: Exact client timing, active roadblock ordinary-WALK navigation, target priority and unsupported effects remain UNKNOWN unless supplied evidence says otherwise.

c1_conditioned_counterexamples.sp_model: time recovery 1/s while inactive; paused during effect

c1_conditioned_counterexamples.current_simulator_win_rule: zero leaks, all spawn events consumed, no active enemies

decision_task.required_uncertainty_discipline: Do not turn model-derived counterexamples or UNKNOWN mechanics into confirmed game impossibility.

previous_c1_plan_to_revise.tactical_thesis: Two-medic two-chokepoint crossfire. Fang+Vanilla open for DP and early block, then hand off to Noirc[1,6] top and Beagle[4,6] bottom. Kroos[2,6] LEFT fires on both lanes (row1 cols3-6 and row3 cols3-6). Stward[5,6] UP and Popka[4,7] (post-Vanilla) shred the bottom pile; Hibiscus[5,7] UP heals (4,6),(4,7),(5,8); Lancet-2[2,9] LEFT heals top. Melantha[1,7] LEFT adds top burst and catches leakers. All manual skills are banked for the t130-175 flood; Cardigan[5,8] is deployed late as flood-tail backstop. No roadblock tile is ever deployed on; no unsupported mechanic is load-bearing.
